packages.description: Ringe 2022 pp.55-56: changes a-d then stress f, restricted to explicitly accent-marked VCV/VCVCV controls; excludes clusters, later changes e/g and full PIE-to-Germanic derivations.
Deliberately reversed chronology control, not an attributed historical theory.
Kloekhorst 2006 pp.82-91,105: restricted Hittite written-onset projection, with h2/h3 loss before o and h3 loss before resonants. Unwritten glottal stop is not a claim of phonetic absence.
Retention comparison attributed to Melchert 1987 as reported by Kloekhorst 2006 pp.85-86. Primary Melchert PDF unavailable; attribution and scope require specialist review.
